name: Mainstays Super Soft Gray Plaid Plush Blanket (Full/Queen 90x90 in)
description: Snuggle up in instant warmth and cozy country style! This genuine Mainstays 90x90 inch Full/Queen size plush blanket features a timeless, farmhouse-inspired gray and white plaid check pattern face that looks fantastic draped over any bed or living room sofa. Crafted from an exceptionally soft, premium low-pill polyester fleece on the front, it reverses to a layer of thick, fluffy faux sherpa wool lining underneath to trap body heat instantly on chilly nights. Highly breathable, lightweight yet heavily insulating, and safely machine washable without shedding or fading. Please note: This comes from a pet-friendly home with a cat. The blanket has been freshly laundered, fully sanitized, and meticulously lint-rolled before listing. In great clean condition with no holes, frays, or loose seams!
contact_note: Cat-friendly home. Freshly washed with premium unscented allergen-free detergent and fully sanitized right before listing. Please note that it does not include a storage bag, so please bring a hamper, tote, or box for transport during local porch pickup!
meta_description: Pre-owned Mainstays 90x90" full/queen gray plaid plush blanket with white sherpa reverse side in good condition. Freshly laundered, pet-friendly home, no storage bag.
name_zh: 宜家/沃尔玛 Mainstays 双面加厚羊羔绒格子保暖毛毯被 (90x90英寸 Full/Queen)
